subject.title: Theme Customization System — Preset Themes + Custom Theme Studio

question: Should Control UI theming stay with Claw/Knot/Dash plus one browser-local tweakcn import slot, or should OpenClaw sponsor a built-in preset gallery and Custom Theme Studio with a broader persistence contract?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally expose a narrower import model, while this issue asks for a larger in-product authoring and settings surface that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Define a narrow core theming roadmap
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset, preview, studio, accessibility, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

options.title: Keep tweakcn-only customization
options.body: Document the current one-slot tweakcn import as the supported customization path and close or narrow the larger in-app studio request.

options.title: Split staged theme work
options.body: Track interactive preview, gateway-backed persistence, accessibility presets, and per-variable local editing as separate product-approved slices.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow core theming roadmap
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset, preview, studio, accessibility, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is assigned on the issue and authored the current custom-theme import path that this request would expand or replace.
